scenarios.title: Vault: a gold reveal pays from the stash at once and reveals every held item
scenarios.pending_reason: not run, and it cannot run as a measured gate scenario: a gold reveal is a player-paid write (`debug paygold`, ADR 0029) that the bot and the fork both refuse in a measured run (D2BOT_RUN, lockstep). It needs an unmeasured lane first. Also missing in the framework: a SETUP that seeds N unidentified vault records WITH held affixes (the fork's `item create` records no sealed affix string, so the seeding writes the vault log directly), a driver that posts the order to the answer listener (`POST /api/vault/revealgold`, as the board-taps driver does for the quest board), and assertions that read the vault log (`vault_identified`, `vault_order_state`) and the stash gold after the payment. The lab d2d must run with --vault-verbs and --vault-pay.
scenarios.provenance: Hero created fresh, level, purse and stash gold by stat verbs, the vault records with held affixes seeded in the vault log (CHEATED setup: mechanics evidence only, never balance). The reveal itself is the one allowed player-paid write (ADR 0029), so the run is NOT a measured run.

assert.why: 6 reveals at the Scroll of Identify price (80) left the stash: 7200 - 480 = 6720

scenarios.notes: Hero in town, 6 unidentified vault records with held affixes, 500 gold in the purse and 7200 in the stash, knob loot.vaultRevealGold 1, an order for all 6 posted. Expected: all 6 records identified in the same minute (no town visit, no scroll bought, no tome use), the stash down by 6 x the vendor price of a Scroll of Identify, the purse unchanged, the order ends revealed, one cheat ledger line `vault gold reveal order g-...`. RED on today's main is the instant mechanism not existing; GREEN is the order chain queued, paid, revealed.
